contexts.text: At one side there was a treasury... which contained resplendent garments. BE 120. TCR 188.
The Angel guard came from the treasury, and brought... resplendent garments...
Follow me to our treasury. We followed, and he showed us the writings of the Most Ancients...
The chambers are resplendent, being filled as it were with treasures of many precious things.
The Conjugial, which is the treasure of the Christian life, CL 466:2. CL 512:2.
It is not only a treasure in their heart, but also a precious thing in their mouth.
Like a closed house full of treasures and treasuries.
The places or treasuries for the interior libraries appeared more and more lucid...
To the left also there are libraries in treasuries...
